accepted.sentence: In fire stations, ventilated storage compartments let damp turnout clothing dry between calls while keeping protective gear near vehicle bays.
In laundromats, closed storage keeps detergent refills and cleaning supplies away from customer work surfaces.
In gymnasiums, lockable compartments hold balls and practice equipment between scheduled classes and community events.
In photographic darkrooms, opaque drawers shield unexposed paper from stray light until prints are prepared.
In greenhouses, enclosed spaces keep seed packets and hand tools together and away from damp work benches.
In dental practices, enclosed storage protects sterilized instruments until staff prepare treatment rooms.
In electrical substations, weather-resistant enclosures shelter control relays from rain and restrict access to authorized maintenance workers.
In hotel housekeeping rooms, enclosed storage keeps spare bedding sorted by size and ready for room turnover.
